Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0021 2026-09-22
SHIFT NOTES — Documentation Backlog and the
Electrical Filing List
Date: 2026-09-22
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
13:05 — Afternoon note from PERSON-0027 for TEAM-0003. Set
aside the electrical filing list for the documentation backlog
conversation. ISSUE-0169 and TASK-0451 identify the relevant
folder; use those references when requesting a collecting
appointment.
13:40 — For each missing paper, distinguish the person
gathering the attachment from any person assignment in the
task records. The documentation coordinator should name a
collecting role and a filing date. The next shift needs a
practical destination even when an assignment question
requires a separate discussion.
14:25 — Keep the question ledger beside the filing list. Enter
the exact question, intended addressee, and promised reply
date. If the request is about an attachment heading, preserve
that heading so the records clerk can search the same index
used by the sender.
16:05 — Ask the records clerk to return an attachment-location
note with any paper delivered during the afternoon. File that
note after the original request, leaving the collecting
appointment visible. An attachment arriving without a filing
location can disappear again at the next handover.
Next-shift list
~- Match the incoming papers to the filing-list headings.
~ Carry unanswered collecting appointments with their promised
dates.
D. Worker 0027
Demo Worker 0027, Demo Team 03
